concept.reason: Actual skull photograph and named skeletal restoration sufficient for original gate; no extra concept image.

scope: Complete adult small pachycephalosaur, retaining rounded relatively low dome and distinct flatter rear skull shelf; full trunk, two arms, two hindlimbs and long tail. Not a skull-only object.

scientific_limits.en: Living reconstruction based on UALVP2 original skull photograph and published skeletal reconstruction. Postcranial remains are exceptional but partial; the complete diagram includes reconstructed portions and is not a photograph of a wholly preserved articulated skeleton. 2m is WitmerLab adult estimate, not soft-tissue measurement. Lower dome is comparative, not juvenile flat skull. Soft tissue, colour and neutral pose inferred. Do not assert head-butting behaviour or hypothetical respiratory turbinates as established external anatomy.
scientific_limits.zh: 活体复原依据UALVP2真头骨照片与公开骨架复原图。躯干骨保存难得但仍不完整，完整示意图包含补全，不是全体原位骨架照片。2米是WitmerLab成年估值而非软组织实测。较低圆顶是比较性特征，不做成幼体平头。软组织、颜色与中性站姿为推断；不把头撞行为或假设呼吸鼻甲作为确定外形。

scale.basis: Ohio University WitmerLab UALVP2 adult factsheet: 2m estimate, skull212mm. Not NHM separate2.4m genus estimate.

diagnostic_targets: Rounded adult dome above eyes, modest relative height rather than giant Pachycephalosaurus bulb.
Clear lower flatter posterior skull shelf extending behind dome; small marginal bumps, not long spikes.
Compact beaked head, short neck, broad trunk and pelvis.
Short forelimbs with palms inward, stout hindlimbs in neutral bipedal stance.
Long tapering relatively stiff balancing tail; no club or plates.
specimen_basis: Actually viewed Ohio WitmerLab facts/images PDF page9: original skull photo P.Currie UniversityAlberta, UALVP2; skeletal restoration C.Brown RoyalTyrrell. PLOS2022 UALVP2 appendicular myology supports broad torso/pelvis and stout hindlimbs.
acceptance_checks: Original lower rounded dome and flatter rear skull shelf simultaneously readable side/front/perspective.
Adult dome retained; reject flat juvenile head, giant balloon dome, long Stygimoloch spikes or missing shelf.
Complete bipedal organism, broad pelvis and stout hindlimbs, short arms and long tapering tail.
Neutral supported stance, not head-butting combat or copied bone diagram as exposed skeleton.
Four standard views only; inferred soft tissues and estimate scale disclosed.
